metaTitle: Custom Pocketed Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom pocketed lanyards and badges for your team. Keep essentials handy with branded badge holders. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Pocketed lanyards and badges add practical utility to your everyday identification needs. Instead of a standard badge holder, these feature built-in pockets that hold pens, cards, or even a phone, reducing the need for extra accessories. For tradeshow staff or event coordinators, a pocketed lanyard means quick access to a stylus or business cards. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or full-color dye sublimation for a professional look that works as hard as your team does.
heroAltText: Custom pocketed lanyards and badges with a clear pocket for holding a smartphone or ID card
